name: app-mpat-tractography
summary: Reconstructs AFQ white matter bundles from DWI and a T1w with MPAT (Markov probabilistic absorbing tractography), computing bundles as expectations over infinitely many streamlines, and outputs per-bundle tractometry metrics and maps.
description: Runs the mpat command (absorbing Markov chain formulation of probabilistic tractography) on the DWI with its bvals and bvecs and the T1w, optionally limited to a list of AFQ bundles, and returns per-bundle density, AFD, length, volume and cross-sectional area with per-bundle maps. Use it to obtain bundle-level tractometry without generating streamlines. Only the first metrics table produced by MPAT is copied to the datatype's csv.csv; the full MPAT output folder is included alongside.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image of the same subject.

outputs.description: Per-bundle tractometry metrics (density, AFD, length, volume, cross-sectional area) and per-bundle maps produced by MPAT.

parameters.description: Number of parallel processors to use
Comma-separated list of AFQ bundle names to run (empty = all bundles)

failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the mpat error.
